integrity: The theorem and checker are original mathematical exposition; third-party papers are cited rather than copied. Numerical tests do not certify the infinite-parameter result.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric pentagonal bipyramids with positive equal apex heights, Haar-uniform orthogonal shadows, and generic directions for vertex counts; historical priority and independent proof validation are outstanding.
title: Complete random-shadow law and a unique seven-vertex optimum for pentagonal bipyramids
